notes.title: Update v1.1
notes.notes:
A new version is now released!


 Add more explanation, pictures, and screens for the tutorial scene. Pictures explaining teleport, grabbing objects, head shaking gesture, toggle+touchpad actions, using the watch will make the game bit less confusing. 
 Fixed automatic doors for stopping in the middle.
 If objects are lost under the ground, they will spawn back on certain spots. 
 Few book covers are added to show the game theme bit clearer.
 Indicator arrows are added after keys are put.
